scope: Read-only manufacturer-document review for Amazon procurement; no CAD, BOM or cart mutations by this reviewer.

bzt52c5v1_13_f.decision: Accept as packaging-only alternative to BZT52C5V1-7-F when listing actually declares Diodes Incorporated BZT52C5V1-13-F or exact MPN; marketplace provenance remains a separate unresolved issue.
bzt52c5v1_13_f.basis: Manufacturer ordering table assigns both commercial SOD123 parts. -7-F original reel contains 3000 devices; -13-F contains 10000. Shared BZT52C5V1 electrical row, case drawing, polarity and matte-tin lead-free finish apply.
bzt52c5v1_13_f.electrical: 5.1 V nominal, 4.8 to 5.4 V at 5 mA, shared BZT52C5V1 row. Ratings are unchanged by reel suffix.
bzt52c5v1_13_f.soldering: MSL 1 per J-STD-020 and matte-tin lead-free plating per common mechanical section. Same component soldering compatibility as planned -7-F; actual hotplate/profile qualification remains separate.
bzt52c5v1_13_f.document: DS18004 Rev. 38-2, October 2017, page 1 ordering and mechanical data, page 2 shared electrical row, page 4 shared SOD123 drawing

bzt52c5v1_7_without_f.decision: Do not accept as a documented lead-free equivalent solely from an abbreviated listing name.
bzt52c5v1_7_without_f.basis: The current source ordering table only covers -7-F and -13-F commercial forms. Historical Diodes Product Design Guide states -F identifies lead-free or lead-free-finish products while SnPb-finished versions may remain. This supports treating missing -F as a finish ambiguity, not proof of RoHS or matching reflow qualification.
bzt52c5v1_7_without_f.document_location: Diodes Incorporated Product Design Guide, printed page 1-2 (PDF page 11), Lead Free and Green Products
bzt52c5v1_7_without_f.limit: No exact historical BZT52C5V1-7 material declaration or soldering profile was established. Do not claim it is definitely leaded; the specific listing may simply omit suffix, requiring evidence.

bat46w_7_f.decision: A listing with the identical BAT46W-7-F MPN and SOD123 package is a seller/source change, not an electrical substitution. Generic seller branding does not establish Diodes manufacturing origin or authenticity.
bat46w_7_f.basis: Exact orderable MPN BAT46W-7-F; SOD123; 3000 original tape-and-reel; matte-tin finish; cathode-band polarity; lead-free and RoHS declaration. Nominal product summary 100 V and 150 mA.
